title: C++ Code Intelligence for Copilot CLI in Public Preview
description: GitHub Copilot CLI now supports C++ code intelligence in public preview, expanding language support for command-line development workflows.

title: Bring Your Own Language Model Key in VS Code
description: Users can now bring their own language model keys in VS Code, providing flexibility in model selection and usage.

title: Copilot Code Review User Counts in Usage Metrics API
description: Copilot code review user counts now aggregate in usage metrics API, providing better telemetry for organizations.

title: CodeQL Supports Sanitizers and Validators in Models-as-Data
description: CodeQL now supports sanitizers and validators in models-as-data approach, enhancing security analysis capabilities.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI Now Supports Copilot Auto Model Selection
description: Copilot CLI now supports automatic model selection, optimizing model choice based on the task context.

title: Manage Agent Skills with GitHub CLI
description: Users can now manage agent skills using GitHub CLI, providing programmatic control over Copilot agent capabilities.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 Generally Available
description: Claude Opus 4.7 is now generally available in GitHub Copilot, expanding model options for users.

title: Enable Copilot Cloud Agent via Custom Properties
description: Organizations can now enable Copilot cloud agent via custom properties, providing more granular control over agent deployment.

title: Model Selection for Claude and Codex Agents on GitHub.com
description: Model selection improvements for Claude and Codex agents on github.com, giving users more control over AI model choices.

title: Deployment Context in Repository Properties and Alerts
description: Deployment context is now available in repository properties and alerts, improving security visibility for production deployments.

title: Link Code Scanning Alerts to GitHub Issues
description: Code scanning alerts can now be linked to GitHub Issues, streamlining security vulnerability tracking and remediation.

title: Copilot Data Residency in US + EU and FedRAMP Compliance
description: Copilot now offers data residency in US + EU and FedRAMP compliance, addressing enterprise data governance requirements.

title: Remote Control CLI Sessions on Web and Mobile in Public Preview
description: Remote control CLI sessions are now available in public preview on web and mobile, enabling flexible terminal access.

title: Version 0.38.0 - Chapters Narrative Flow and Context Compression
description: Released April 14, 2026 featuring Chapters Narrative Flow for intent-based grouping, Context Compression Service, UI Flicker fixes with Terminal Buffer mode, and Persistent Policy Approvals for tool execution.

title: Version 0.37.0 - Dynamic Sandbox Expansion and Advanced Browser Capabilities
description: Released April 8, 2026 featuring dynamic sandbox expansion and worktree support, Chapters Narrative Flow for better session structure, and enhanced browser agent with persistent sessions.

title: Copilot CLI Now Supports BYOK and Local Models
description: Copilot CLI now supports Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) and local models, giving developers flexibility in model deployment and cost management.

title: Organization Runner Controls for Copilot Cloud Agent
description: Organizations can now control runners for Copilot cloud agent, providing better resource management and security controls.

title: Copilot SDK in Public Preview
description: GitHub Copilot SDK is now in public preview, enabling developers to build custom integrations and extensions.

title: GPT-5.4 Mini in Copilot Student Auto Model Selection
description: GPT-5.4 mini is now available in Copilot Student auto model selection, providing more efficient model options for educational users.

title: Research, Plan, and Code with Copilot Cloud Agent
description: Copilot cloud agent can now research, plan, and code with improved capabilities. Remote control CLI sessions available in public preview on web and mobile.

title: Canvases - Interactive Visualizations
description: Cursor can now respond by creating interactive canvases with dashboards and custom interfaces built using first-party components like tables, boxes, diagrams, and charts. Canvases are durable artifacts in the Agents Window side panel.

title: CLI Debug Mode and /btw Support
description: Quality-of-life improvements to Cursor CLI including /debug for root cause analysis, /btw for side questions without derailing tasks, and /config for interactive settings panel.
